title: 第17章 水晶莲藕桃花等于水晶桃花糕第18章 透明的糯米粉水晶糕稳了
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
“蘑菇？”
沐倾城深吸了一口气，硕果起伏。
似乎很震惊！
火灵儿低头，直接就能看到自己的脚面，呆毛顿时蔫了。
她用羡慕的目光看着沐倾城胸前。
林东方笑道，“我修炼厨道，需要用蘑菇做调料或者入菜，但是咱们瑶池圣地内的蘑菇和外面的不太一样，我不敢轻易尝试，所以来问问灵药峰的师姐们有没有相关资料。”
“若是有得罪的地方，请师姐见谅。”
他施了一礼。
人家灵药峰是培育、研究灵药的地方，跑到这里来问蘑菇确实有点不妥。
但林东方实在想不到别处去问了。
沐倾城见到林东方诚恳的样子，微微一叹。
“罢了，你们随我来。”
林东方和火灵儿对视一眼，都笑了起来。
看来有戏！
不过火灵儿看着沐倾城的背影，又羡慕起来。
对方走路的样子让她想到了大橘猫。
这不是故意扭扭作态，而是因为身材实在是好到了那种地步。
她手背到身后摸了摸，越发觉得自己是干瘪的小豆芽。
林东方倒是没多注意沐倾城的背影，他在看远处的灵药园。
只有过了大门才能看到灵药峰真正的景色。

在山下向上看，就只能看到一些凡俗树木，有迷阵笼罩着整个灵药峰。
而灵药峰内部也是迷阵重重，自然是为了防备小偷之类的。
一进入灵药峰，就可以看到一挂百丈瀑布，耳边也忽然响起水流倾泻的声音。
瀑布下是一处寒潭，其中长了一些荷花，只是花朵和荷叶都略微透明，像是水晶一样。
注意到他的目光，沐倾城介绍道，“这是水晶荷花，通体晶莹，连莲藕都是水晶一样通透。”
“真不知道这莲藕炒熟是什么口感…”
沐倾城微笑道，“这水晶荷花不是灵药，莲藕的滋味倒也不错，等下给林师弟拔几根。”
“多谢师姐！”
林东方激动起来！
这可是未知的食材，是全新的领域啊！
往灵药峰深处走去，周围各种灵木相继显现。
若是没有人领路，基本上小命就交代在这迷阵中了。
林东方看着那些高达百丈，结满了硕果的蟠桃树，顿时知道孙猴子进了蟠桃园为啥只吃桃子了。
这种果子光是闻味道就让他觉得飘飘欲仙！
“这些蟠桃还有几十年才能成熟，这边的桃子倒是熟了，你们若是没吃过这蟠桃，我倒是建议你们领取一枚。”
“这种蟠桃只有我瑶池圣地才有，外面是寻不到的。”
content_en:
"Mushrooms?"
Mu Qingcheng took a deep breath, and the results rose and fell.
Seems shocked!
Huo Ling'er lowered his head and could directly see the top of his feet, and Da Mao suddenly withered.
She looked at Mu Qingcheng's chest with envy.
Lin Dongfang smiled and said, "I practice cooking and need to use mushrooms to make seasonings or dishes, but the mushrooms in our Yaochi Holy Land are different from those outside. I don't dare to try them easily, so I came to ask the senior sisters at Spiritual Medicine Peak if they have any relevant information."
"If I have offended anything, please forgive me, senior sister."
He saluted.
The elixir peak is a place where elixirs are cultivated and studied. It is indeed inappropriate to come here and ask about mushrooms.
But Lin Dongfang really couldn't think of anywhere else to ask.
Mu Qingcheng sighed slightly when he saw Lin Dongfang's sincere look.
"That's all, come with me."
Lin Dongfang and Huo Ling'er looked at each other and laughed.
Looks like there's something going on!
However, Huo Ling'er looked at Mu Qingcheng's back and became envious again.
The way the other person walked reminded her of a big orange cat.
This is not intentional, but because the figure is really that good.
She put her hand behind her back and touched it, feeling more and more that she was a shriveled little bean sprout.
Lin Dongfang didn't pay much attention to Mu Qingcheng's back. He was looking at the elixir garden in the distance.
Only after passing the gate can you see the real scenery of Lingyao Peak.
Looking up from the bottom of the mountain, you can only see some ordinary trees, and there is a maze covering the entire elixir peak.
The interior of Spiritual Medicine Peak is also full of mazes, naturally to guard against thieves and the like.
As soon as you enter the Spiritual Medicine Peak, you can see a hundred-foot waterfall, and the sound of pouring water suddenly rings in your ears.
Under the waterfall is a cold pool with some lotus flowers growing in it, but the flowers and lotus leaves are slightly transparent, like crystal.
Noticing his gaze, Mu Qingcheng introduced, "This is a crystal lotus. The whole body is crystal clear. Even the lotus root is as transparent as crystal."
"I really don't know what the fried lotus root tastes like..."
Mu Qingcheng smiled and said, "This crystal lotus is not a panacea, but the lotus root tastes pretty good. I'll pull out some roots for Junior Brother Lin later."
"Thank you, senior sister!"
Lin Dongfang became excited!
This is an unknown ingredient, a completely new field!
Walking deeper into the Spiritual Medicine Peak, various spiritual trees appeared one after another around them.
If there is no one to lead the way, your life will basically be decided in this maze.
Lin Dongfang looked at the peach trees that were hundreds of feet high and full of fruits, and he suddenly knew why Monkey Sun only ate peaches when he entered the peach orchard.
Just the smell of this fruit makes him feel ecstatic!
"These flat peaches will take decades to mature, but the peaches here are ripe. If you haven't eaten these flat peaches, I suggest you get one."
"This kind of flat peach is only found in our Yaochi Holy Land and cannot be found outside."
